analysis.title: Fiserv Inc. (FISV): 3Q26 First Take: Against low bar, reiteration of guidance should support stock
key_insights: GS expects FISV to trade well on a relatively in-line 3Q26, a reiterated FY26 guide and several clearing-event data points that point to stabilization after a year of revenue declines.
3Q26 adjusted revenue was ~$4.85bn, in line with Visible Alpha consensus, down 1% y/y. Merchant Solutions was down 3% (down 2% organic) and Financial Solutions was flat (down 4% organic).
Adjusted EPS was $1.75 against $1.71 consensus and a GS estimate of $1.73. Adjusted operating income of ~$1.51bn was in line with the Street, at a 31.2% margin.
GS called the numbers modestly better than expected and at the favorable end of the company's guided revenue decline of 1% to 3%.
Balance sheet: the company ended the quarter at 3.1x leverage and is targeting half a billion dollars of share repurchases in 4Q. 3Q26 repurchases were only $2mn against $226mn consensus.
Core attrition in Financial Solutions is down 25% YTD, which GS reads as evidence that management's effort to stabilize the segment over the past 12 months is working.
Clover is guided to positive reported revenue growth. The company shared several cuts of the Clover revenue base that GS says indicate an underlying growth run rate in the low double digits.
Merchant Solutions was the weak spot. Revenue of ~$2.52bn missed ~$2.58bn consensus, and operating income of $724mn missed the Street's $795mn, with a margin of 28.7% against 30.8% expected.
Clover GPV rose 9% reported (11% excluding gateway conversion). Clover revenue grew 1% reported against 3% consensus, while Clover processing revenue rose 12%.

Financial Solutions beat. Adjusted revenue of ~$2.33bn compared with ~$2.28bn consensus, and operating income of $887mn carried a 38.1% margin against 37.4% expected. Issuing revenue of $840mn was 7% above consensus.
Cash flow was soft. Adjusted free cash flow was $679mn against $869mn consensus, and FCF conversion was 73% against 96% expected.

FY26 guidance was reaffirmed: organic growth of -1% to 0%, adjusted revenue growth of -1.5% to -0.5%, adjusted operating margin of 31% to 31.5%, adjusted EPS of $7.20 to $7.40 and FCF conversion of ~90%.
The FY26 guide implies 4Q26 adjusted revenue of $5,017mn to $5,215mn (midpoint $5,116mn against $5,043mn consensus) and adjusted EPS of $1.82 to $2.02 (midpoint $1.92 against $1.89 consensus).
Positioning heading into the print was negative based on GS investor conversations, which supports the expectation that the stock trades well on results.
GS keeps a Neutral rating and a $56 12-month price target. The stock closed at $51.93 on 2 Nov 2026, implying 7.8% upside.

market_movers.rationale: In-line 3Q26 with a reiterated FY26 guide and stabilization signals in Financial Solutions and Clover. GS expects the stock to trade well against negative positioning but stays Neutral.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported 11/3: adjusted revenue ~$4.85bn vs Visible Alpha consensus ~$4.85bn (GS est $4.84bn), -1% y/y.
3Q26 reported 11/3: adjusted EPS $1.75 (non-GAAP) vs consensus $1.71 and GS est $1.73. Down 14% y/y from $2.04 in 3Q25.
3Q26 reported 11/3: adjusted operating income ~$1.51bn (31.2% margin) vs consensus ~$1.51bn (31.1% margin).
3Q26 reported 11/3: Merchant Solutions revenue ~$2.52bn vs consensus ~$2.58bn, operating income $724mn vs $795mn consensus, margin 28.7% vs 30.8%.
3Q26 reported 11/3: Financial Solutions revenue ~$2.33bn vs consensus ~$2.28bn, operating income $887mn vs $853mn consensus, margin 38.1% vs 37.4%.
FY26 company guidance (reaffirmed): adjusted EPS $7.20-$7.40 vs consensus $7.23. Adjusted revenue growth -1.5% to -0.5% vs consensus -1.4%. Adjusted operating margin 31%-31.5% vs consensus 31.2%.
Implied 4Q26 guide (derived by GS from the FY26 guide, not a company-stated figure): adjusted EPS $1.82-$2.02 vs consensus $1.89, and adjusted revenue $5,017mn-$5,215mn vs consensus $5,043mn.
FY26 FCF is guided to ~$3.5bn at ~90% conversion, against consensus of $3,498mn at 91%. The implied 4Q26 FCF of $1,526mn-$1,622mn compares with $1,282mn consensus.
GS forecasts (estimates): FY26E EPS $7.26, FY27E EPS $7.81, FY28E EPS $8.62. 4Q26E EPS is $1.90 and 1Q27E EPS is $1.67.
risk_factors: Key downside risks named by GS: weaker macro environment, regulation and competition.
Key upside risks named by GS: better than expected macro, competition and regulation.
Merchant Solutions operating income and margin missed consensus by a wide margin in 3Q26.
Adjusted FCF and FCF conversion fell well short of consensus in 3Q26. The FY26 guide requires 4Q26 FCF conversion of about 156% at the midpoint.
Argentina exposure inside Clover is a variable GS wants separated from reported numbers.
vol_and_positioning: Positioning heading into earnings was negative based on GS investor conversations, which GS cites as a reason the stock should trade well on in-line results.
